'''Galsol''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Belderone sector/Legends|Belderone sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

The [[Galsol strip]] was known for its [[Casino/Legends|casinos]].
